title: Barriers and facilitating conditions in the implementation of AI-based systems for the interpretation of 2D radiographs in dental practice
summary: This study investigates the factors that facilitate or hinder the use of artificial intelligence (AI)-based software for the interpretation of two-dimensional dental radiographs in dental practices. First, dentists will complete an online survey about their experiences, expectations, and concerns regarding the use of AI in dental practice. Subsequently, a number of dental practices will implement such a system in their daily clinical workflow and participate in interviews to share their experiences. The aim of the study is to gain a better understanding of the conditions that support the successful and meaningful integration of this technology into routine dental care.
conditions: Use of AI-based systems for the interpretation of two-dimensional dental radiographs in dentistry

interventions.name:
Quantitative study component:
Dentists will complete a one-time questionnaire assessing their perceptions, expectations, concerns, and perceived barriers and facilitators regarding the use of artificial intelligence (AI)-based systems for the interpretation of two-dimensional dental radiographs.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Quantitative Study Component
- Practicing dentists and dental residents (assistant dentists)
- Willingness to participate and provide electronic informed consent
- Sufficient proficiency in German or English to fully understand the questionnaire and the participant information

2. Qualitative Study Component
- Licensed dentists practicing in Germany (including employed and self-employed dentists)
- Working in a dental practice that will be involved in the implementation process of the AI-based system
- Willingness to participate and provide written informed consent
- Sufficient proficiency in German to participate fully in an interview
Exclusion criteria:
Failure to meet the inclusion criteria.
